description.value: Boketto Dessert Cafe (also trading as Boketto Tea Bar) is a bubble tea and dessert café in Vancouver's River District neighbourhood, specializing in matcha drinks, soft serve, and freshly baked cookies. The café offers both in-store service and online ordering with pickup or delivery via Uber Eats and DoorDash. It serves as a community-oriented spot in the newer Sawmill Crescent mixed-use development area.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content at bokettoteabar.com confirms the address, phone, and general business details matching OSM tags. The website title is 'Boketto Tea Bar' while OSM lists 'Boketto Dessert Cafe' (Instagram handle @bokettodessertcafe suggests both names are in use). Takeout is explicitly confirmed via order links and third-party delivery services. No bike-specific amenities, washrooms, or Wi-Fi are mentioned on the website; the only parking reference is 'free underground retail parking' for vehicles.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM lists 'Boketto Dessert Cafe' but the website title and branding consistently use 'Boketto Tea Bar'. The Instagram handle @bokettodessertcafe suggests both names are in circulation; OSM name retained per rules.
